title: Ratchet & Clank Future: Tools of Destruction
subtitle: A new galaxy for an old partnership

body: Ratchet & Clank Future: Tools of Destruction is Insomniac Games' PlayStation 3 platform shooter, released in North America on 23 October 2007. Emperor Tachyon's attack sends Ratchet and Clank into a journey connected to the Lombaxes and their disappearance. The pair travel between planets, gathering weapons and gadgets as the story begins the series' Future saga. Familiar jumping and shooting return in larger, more detailed surroundings. Ratchet remains the main playable character, with Clank supplying both practical abilities and a mystery that the adventure gradually brings forward.

Ratchet's arsenal turns combat into a choice between conspicuously different effects. A weapon that works well against a group may serve another purpose when an enemy keeps its distance. Using equipment develops it, encouraging the player to return to a favourite tool while trying newly purchased additions. Bolts gathered around the levels fund that growing collection. Movement between battles includes jumping, gliding and gadget-assisted traversal, so a planet provides more than another arena: it also asks how Ratchet's changing equipment can carry him through its obstacles.

Some weapons and movement sections use the SIXAXIS controller's tilt sensing, including sequences where Ratchet falls through the air. These passages briefly change the physical action asked of the player without abandoning the adventure's established controls. Brian Allgeier directed the game, with David Bergeaud continuing his work on the series' music. Critics welcomed the presentation and familiar mixture of platforming and comic weaponry. The ending left the partners' story open, leading into Quest for Booty and then A Crack in Time on PlayStation 3.
